definitions.modelReservations: M. run.observed.modelCalls. Driver reserve count, equals trace request events. Includes consumed rejected generations. Not accepted handles or billing.
definitions.acceptedEvents: A. Persisted task_accepted events. Count recovery snapshot events only as saved. Missing history stays unknown.
definitions.knownActualHandleUnion: Distinct non-empty task IDs from saved dispatch states/events and driver reply events. Opaque actual dispatch evidence, not model-server or billing attestation.
definitions.deliveredEvents: D. Persisted reply_delivered callback-success events, including non-output error delivery.
definitions.driverReplies: R. trace.events kind=reply. Includes output and non-output error; separate from callback success.
definitions.physicalSourceChecks: S. run.checks.length, cross-checked with trace kind=tool.
definitions.sharedCalls: Driver M+S. Reservation count plus physical scripted source retrievals.
definitions.sdkModelGenerations: Tombo trace.events[kind=sdk_result].result.result.state.usage.modelCalls. Baseline per-trial null, aggregate zero by non-applicability; not a claim that baseline generates nothing.
definitions.sdkExecutorAttempts: E. Tombo trace.events[kind=sdk_result].result.result.state.usage.toolCalls. Baseline per-trial null, aggregate zero by non-applicability. One undeclared-source failure precedes physical source reservation.
definitions.requestedProfile: Run/bridge requested codex/gpt-6.1-sol/low. Reply profileMetadataAttestation is the saved echo, not independent upstream effort proof.
definitions.durationMs: Driver elapsed wall-clock time includes transport, review, poll and terminal recording. Not isolated provider generation time.
definitions.visibleUpstreamToolCalls: UNKNOWN. Upstream activity was not read; do not report zero.
definitions.completeDispatchTimeline: Checkpoint/persistence declaration only, not proof every driver reservation has saved dispatch. allDriverRequestsHaveSavedDispatch checks sequence coverage independently.
